0022600140.text: The Pelicans (0-3, with three straight losses) host the Denver Nuggets (1-1, riding a one-game win streak) in New Orleans for their fourth game of the season, with New Orleans 13th in the West and Denver 7th. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, and he averages 9.5 points and 19.6 minutes per game this season, while Denver is without Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The Pelicans trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 141-135 in Denver on October 24, and they were swept 0-3 by the Nuggets in the 2025-26 season.
